Segment metrics

Source: R/TRACK.R
track_metrics.Rd

Distance, duration, speed and bearing for every segment of a track model. For longitude and latitude, distance is geodesic in metres and bearing is the initial geodesic azimuth in degrees, as from track_distance() and track_bearing(). Otherwise distance is Euclidean in the units of the coordinates, and bearing is the planar direction clockwise from the y axis.

track_metrics(x, ...)

Arguments

x

a track model, or anything as_track() accepts

...

unused

Value

track_segments() with columns distance, speed (distance per second) and bearing.

Examples

head(track_metrics(trips0))
#>   .seg .track .fix0 .fix1       x0        y0       x1        y1
